thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: realtime p99 latency spike detected for /v1/stream (us-west-2) — p95 jumped 120ms -> ~680ms, p99 jumped 450ms -> ~2.1s. SLO (p99 < 1s) breached. Paging eng-oncall, eng-runtime.

maya: on it. grabbing quick dashboards + logs :eyes:

jon: quick check — prometheus shows an abrupt tail shift around 10:04 UTC. sample queries:
```
# p95/p99 rolling 5m for /v1/stream
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/stream"}[5m])) by (le))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route="/v1/stream"}[5m])) by (le))
```
jon: numbers from grafana (10:02 -> 10:06): p95=120ms -> 680ms, p99=420ms -> 2.05s.

chris: seeing lots of "write timeout to backend" logs on streamer workers, also GPU util on some nodes dropped to 5% while queue depth rose. could be a stall/GC or driver issue.

lia: checked autoscaler events — no recent scale-downs at 10:00, but several instances in the pool returned non-ready and then flapped 10:03-10:05.

dave: streaming chunk wait traces show many chunks stuck waiting on kv-cache miss + disk fallback. sample log: 
```
[10:04:52] stream-handler client=abc123 stall_count=18 state=waiting_kv_cache
[10:05:01] model-infer err=rpc timeout backend=pool-node-27
```

maya: initial mitigation proposal:
- route new traffic away from us-west-2 to us-east-1 fallback pool (gradual 20% steps)
- enable model-variant fallback to smaller quantized model (risky quality tradeoff) for streaming endpoints
- temporarily reduce batch size / disable continuous batching for /v1/stream
- restart flaky pool nodes (pool-node-25..28)

jon: quick runbook steps I'm doing now:
1) run `curl https://ops-api/re-route -d '{"route":"/v1/stream","from":"us-west-2","to":"us-east-1","percent":20}'` to shift 20%
2) flip `streaming.degraded_mode=true` (this switches to chunked ack and shorter kv timeouts)
3) kick restart on pool-node-26 (graceful)

lia: 10:13 — routed 20% to us-east-1, seeing immediate drop for that subset: p99 ~ 700ms on routed traffic vs 2.0s on remaining. :thumbsup:

chris: 10:15 — restarted pool-node-26, it came back ready but logs show libnvml driver complaining about GPU resets; opening infra ticket.

dave: turned on additional kv-cache telemetry and snapshotting to S3; will pull histograms after 10m.

maya: customer impact note for ops: affected customers are those hitting realtime streaming endpoint in us-west-2. Estimated impacted QPS ~ 1200, error rate not high but latency severe for tail. Can we draft a short blurb for CS?

lia: drafting message now — will post to #customer-impact after we confirm steady state.

jon: 10:20 — also saw a spike in network retransmits between inference hosts and kv-store at 10:03-10:06 (possible network blip). contacting infra-nwk.

sri: taking lead for incident at 10:22. Sri here — thanks team. Priority: stabilize p99, confirm root (node driver vs network vs kv). I'll coordinate with infra-nwk and eng-runtime.

maya: handoff notes to Sri: what we did so far and results:
- 20% traffic rerouted -> p99 for routed dropped to ~700ms (good)
- restarted node-26 -> node came back but libnvml noise
- enabled degraded_mode -> slight improvement for in-flight streams
- alerted infra-nwk for retransmits

incident-bot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-4591, severity=P2.

sri: next actions (short):
- step up reroute to 50% if p99 continues high on remaining traffic (do gradual 10% increments)
- ask infra to cordon/replace nodes 25-28 if nvml/GPU resets persist
- collect flamegraphs from 10:00-10:10 for inference process
- keep CS notified, post interim blurb in 10m

chris: assigning infra contact @dave to follow GPU resets; I'll keep looking at rpc timeouts.

dave: on it, engaging host team. I can cordon 25/27 next.

maya: thanks — small wins so far. please keep all steps and timestamps in this thread for the postmortem. :memo:

sri: acknowledged. I'll update every 10 minutes or on any change. taking over now.

jon: 10:28 — pushed additional quick metric: tail latency percentiles by instance, sending snapshot to the incident ticket.

lia: 10:30 — CS blurb posted to #customer-impact: "We're investigating increased tail latency for realtime streaming in us-west-2. Some requests may see longer response times. We're routing traffic to alternate region and actively mitigating. Will update in 15 minutes."

sri: 10:40 — current status: p99 slowly trending down on remaining traffic after another 20% reroute (now 40% away). still above SLO but improvement. planned: continue reroute to 70% if no regression, and infra to replace 25/27.

maya: note for postmortem: get kernel/GPU driver versions for nodes 25-28, check nvml bug database, and correlate with autoscaler events.

sri: closing interim update. tagging this thread PD-4591. will move to postmortem draft after incident is resolved. :white_check_mark:
